pattern: join on two keys and derive one measure from each table
question: district wise 2023: ANC completed over registered and employed over enrolled as percentages from both tables
gold_sql: SELECT a.district, ROUND(100.0 * a.anc4_completed / a.pregnancies_registered, 1) AS anc_percent, ROUND(100.0 * l.employed_at_6_months / l.women_enrolled, 1) AS employment_percent FROM anc_visits AS a INNER JOIN livelihoods AS l ON a.district = l.district AND a.year = l.year WHERE a.year = 2023 ORDER BY a.district
sql_duckdb: SELECT COALESCE(a.district, l.district) AS district, (a.anc4_completed * 100.0) / NULLIF(NULLIF(a.pregnancies_registered, 0), 0) AS anc_completion_pct, (l.employed_at_6_months * 100.0) / NULLIF(NULLIF(l.women_enrolled, 0), 0) AS employment_pct FROM anc_visits AS a FULL OUTER JOIN livelihoods AS l ON a.district = l.district AND a.year = l.year WHERE a.year = 2023 OR l.year = 2023

district wise 2023: ANC completed over registered and employed over enrolled as percentages from both tables
attempts.response:
```sql
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.district, l.district) AS district,
    (a.anc4_completed * 100.0) / NULLIF(a.pregnancies_registered, 0) AS anc_completion_pct,
    (l.employed_at_6_months * 100.0) / NULLIF(l.women_enrolled, 0) AS employment_pct
FROM
    anc_visits a
FULL OUTER JOIN
    livelihoods l
ON
    a.district = l.district
    AND a.year = l.year
WHERE
    a.year = 2023
    OR l.year = 2023;
```
